skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator for unlike fractional denominators and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts that have the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Work with mixed and whole numbers
skills.definition: Separate mixed or whole numbers into whole-number and fractional parts, align missing parts as zero, subtract whole parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow for fractional subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into fractional units when the minuend fractional part is smaller than the subtrahend fractional part.

skills.name: Normalize final answer
skills.definition: Express the final result in standard form by reducing fractions to lowest terms or removing zero whole or fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator, including cases with zero or improper numerators.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator for unlike denominators and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Manage mixed and whole-number parts
skills.definition: Separate mixed or whole-number operands into whole and fractional parts, treat missing parts as zero when needed, subtract whole parts, and combine the resulting whole and fraction.

skills.name: Borrow across whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into denominator-sized fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Express the final result in simplest acceptable form by reducing fractional common factors and replacing zero fractional parts with an integer or zero.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator for unlike fractional parts and convert fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts with the same denominator by subtracting numerators while keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Handle mixed and whole numbers
skills.definition: Separate mixed or whole numbers into whole and fractional parts, subtract whole-number parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more wholes into fractional form when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero fractional part to the appropriate integer or zero form.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator, typically the LCD, and rewrite unlike fractional parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts with the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Handle mixed and whole parts
skills.definition: Decompose mixed or whole-number quantities into whole and fractional parts, subtract whole-number parts, and assemble the final mixed or integer result.

skills.name: Borrow for negative fraction part
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing one or more whole units as denominator-over-denominator fractions when the fractional subtraction would be negative.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional component to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.

skills.name: Find and convert to a common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike-denominator fraction parts and rewrite the fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Decompose and recombine mixed or whole numbers
skills.definition: Represent mixed numbers or whole numbers as whole-plus-fraction components, subtract whole-number parts, handle implicit zero parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow from the whole number part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as denominator-sized fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify the result
skills.definition: Reduce fractional results to lowest terms and express zero fractional parts as an integer or omitted fraction part.
